headline: [AI Sell-Off!] Nasdaq Plunges [5.3%] as S&P 500 Enters Correction
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: AI Sell-Off! Nasdaq Plunges 5.3% as S&P 500 Enters Correction

US stocks fell sharply on Friday as investors sold shares of AI and chip companies. The S&P 500 dropped 3.7%, the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell 5.3% and the Dow lost nearly 2%. The Nasdaq is now down for 2026.

🔹 The S&P 500 is now more than 10% below its October record high, which is called a "correction". Friday was its seventh losing day in a row, the longest run since early 2020.
🔹 Chip makers were hit hardest: Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom each fell more than 10%. Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's Kospi also fell more than 5% earlier on Friday.
🔹 The Nasdaq had its worst week since March 2020. Also on Friday, President Trump said US tech companies that build AI data centers in other countries will face "a tremendous tax", but he gave no details.
